bugClass: stateful recency — get() does not refresh LRU order
oneLineBug: get() returns map.get(key) without moving the key to most-recently-used, so a recently-READ key is wrongly evicted; only put() refreshes recency
groundTruthProbe: after the spec's worked sequence on capacity 2, get('a') must be 1 and get('b') must be undefined; the buggy impl reverses this (get('a')=undefined, get('b')=2)
notesForScoringOnly: Do NOT show to VE. Best caught by a stateful/model-based test (fc.commands) or the spec's directed sequence. Tests whether the VE exercises READ-then-evict ordering, not just put-based eviction.
